title: Actor identity and sameness
status: development; accepted under R26 (accepted in part 2026-10-07); non-qualifying

cases.title: Same actor_id, different identity providers (distinct)
cases.operation: proposal promoted to accepted; proposer and reviewer roles must be distinct
cases.reason: Equal actor_id with different identity_provider values denotes different actors.

cases.title: Same actor_id, one identity provider absent (distinct)
cases.operation: proposal promoted to accepted; proposer and reviewer roles must be distinct
cases.reason: identity_provider values must be equal or both absent; one absent means different actors.

cases.title: Alias policy merges two references; one proposes and the other reviews
cases.operation: proposal promoted to accepted; proposer and reviewer roles must be distinct
cases.reason: A versioned policy declaration merges the two references, so proposer and reviewer are the same actor.

cases.title: Class-only proposer value human
cases.operation: proposal promoted to accepted; proposer and reviewer roles must be distinct
cases.reason: A class-only value does not identify an actor, so distinctness cannot be determined and the check fails closed.

cases.title: Control: same actor_id and same identity provider (same)
cases.operation: proposal promoted to accepted; proposer and reviewer roles must be distinct
cases.reason: Equal actor_id and equal identity_provider denote the same actor.

cases.title: Control: same actor_id, both identity providers absent (same)
cases.operation: proposal promoted to accepted; proposer and reviewer roles must be distinct
cases.reason: Equal actor_id with both identity_provider values absent denotes the same actor.

notes: The runner's review-independence kind compares two opaque strings (proposer_id, reviewer_id). Before results map actor_id (or the class-only value) to those strings. Actor-reference sameness, provider scoping and alias declarations are NOT_MODELED.
Schema support for actor references in proposals, decisions and assessments is R26-S06 (packet R5).
